items.thesis_one_liner: Affirm's deeply compressed rebound failed when rapid GMV growth could not offset credit normalization, funding sensitivity and negative operating economics.
Positive HELIOS-B data re-underwrote vutrisiran as a credible ATTR-CM expansion asset and reset Alnylam's RNAi franchise path.
AppLovin rerated after Q3 2024 showed AXON-driven growth converting into high-margin earnings power.
AST SpaceMobile rerated after carrier-backed agreements and satellite-launch milestones moved the story from concept toward commercial deployment.
Axon rerated as repeated beat-and-raise quarters showed that recurring cloud, AI and connected public-safety products could compound alongside the hardware franchise.
Dutch Bros rerated when transaction recovery, mobile ordering, improving site selection, rapid unit growth, and operating leverage made the expansion model more credible.
CAVA rerated when traffic-led same-store growth, rapid unit expansion, near-25% restaurant margins, and corporate profitability accumulated into proof of a portable fast-casual model.
CrowdStrike rerated as accelerating net-new ARR, multi-module platform adoption, GAAP profit, and free-cash-flow scale changed the market's estimate of durable security-platform economics.
Carvana rerated from distressed survival risk after operating improvement and a July debt-exchange agreement changed near-term liquidity math.
Duolingo rerated as product-led engagement, paid conversion, AI-enabled Max monetization, and operating leverage compounded without breaking the free-user growth engine.
Enacted U.S. manufacturing incentives transformed the economics of a cash-rich, capacity-constrained module producer with a record multi-year backlog.
Hims' delayed June signal failed on the 63-session hold because it arrived after the GLP-1 shock without fresh liquidity, even though a later Q3 acceleration launched a separate resurrection.
Robinhood rerated as profitable account growth broadened into international crypto, tokenized assets and institutional infrastructure, with later S&P 500 inclusion amplifying liquidity.
A stale, compressed COVID-decay prior was forcibly re-underwritten as a repeatable mRNA oncology/immunology platform by a ladder of public catalysts, faster than the biotech sector.
A profitable software chassis became a scarce high-beta Bitcoin treasury proxy, then used convertible debt to increase the exposure during a powerful asset cycle.
Near-50% recurring growth and large-customer expansion combined with stateful edge compute and Zero Trust networking to reframe Cloudflare as a broad internet platform.
Hefei financing removed the survival cliff just as record deliveries, positive vehicle margins, and a new battery-service model established a credible EV turnaround.
A data-center AI demand guide reset forced the market to re-underwrite NVIDIA's forward revenue scale.
Oklo rerated as DOE fuel-facility progress, data-center demand instruments, and balance-sheet runway raised the perceived probability of future advanced-reactor commercialization.
Recurring identity growth, large-enterprise adoption, platform expansion, and improving cash conversion produced a durable software rerating.
Buyer growth, rising spend per buyer, and merchant monetization overcame subsidy and loss concerns to produce a durable China-internet platform rerating.
Pinterest's delayed post-Q1 signal failed when Q2 guidance showed revenue growth decelerating toward the expense-growth rate despite healthy users and cash generation.
Palantir rerated as GAAP profitability, AI Platform demand, and index eligibility accumulated into a year-long model reset.
Roblox's Q3 gap failed when bookings and monetization per user decelerated far faster than lagging recognized revenue implied.
Rubrik rerated as rapid subscription ARR growth, a widening cyber-resilience platform, and improving contribution economics converted a post-IPO growth story into observable cash generation.
Reddit rerated when audience growth, ad acceleration, data licensing, search product optionality, and high-gross-margin cash conversion became visible together.
A large AI-server guide raise and later S&P 500 inclusion forced a fast re-underwriting of Super Micro's revenue scale and liquidity profile.
A small-cap cancer prior was re-underwritten after ivonescimab produced head-to-head HARMONi-2 evidence against pembrolizumab.
A public cost reset, accelerating user growth, improving cash economics, and later pricing power reframed Spotify from spend-heavy streamer to scalable audio platform.
Improving pump economics reduced financing risk before Basal-IQ approval and launch expanded Tandem's attainable automated-insulin-delivery franchise.
Twilio rerated when renewed double-digit growth combined with operating discipline, free cash flow and a credible multi-year profitability framework.
Unity's elevated Q3 and Weta breakaway failed when flaws in its monetization stack cut Operate growth and forced a major guidance reset.
VK2735 obesity Phase 2 data forced a rapid re-underwriting of Viking from clinical option value to credible GLP-1/GIP scarcity asset.
Vertiv rerated as data-center power and cooling demand translated into revenue growth, margin expansion, and repeated outlook raises.
Vistra's second-leg rerating combined acquired nuclear scale, integrated retail hedging, public nuclear price discovery, rising cash-flow guidance, and continued capital return.
XPeng rerated when MONA M03 and P7+ converted a damaged EV prior into repeated delivery records, improving vehicle margin and a visibly broader product cycle.
